style: Franco-Belgian clear-line adventure comic illustration for children aged nine, crisp even black outlines, flat bright colours with simple shadows, detailed precise backgrounds of a Breton island, expressive children with natural proportions, in the spirit of classic illustrated adventure albums. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature, no watermark, no speech bubbles.
style_fiches: Franco-Belgian clear-line adventure comic illustration for children aged nine, crisp even black outlines, flat bright colours with simple shadows, expressive characters with natural proportions. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature, no watermark, no speech bubbles. No scenery, no landscape.

personnages.mael: one eleven-year-old boy, tall and lean with long arms and legs, fair freckled skin tanned by the wind, grey-green eyes, short messy sun-bleached blond hair sticking up at the front, wearing a bright yellow fisherman's oilskin jacket, unzipped, over a navy T-shirt and dark shorts, tall dark green rubber boots, a coil of thin white rope worn across his chest
personnages.enora: one ten-year-old girl of medium height, sturdy with round rosy cheeks, fair skin covered in freckles, brown eyes, very long copper-red hair in two thick braids down to her waist, wearing a bright emerald green knitted sweater with the sleeves pushed up, denim shorts and short black rubber boots, a small beige canvas shoulder bag
personnages.tino: one nine-year-old boy, the smallest of all, thin and wiry, warm brown skin, big dark brown eyes, very short tight black curls, a gap where one front tooth is missing, wearing bright orange fisherman's oilskin bib overalls far too big for him, rolled up at the ankles, over a white T-shirt, small navy rubber boots, a blue plastic bucket in his hand
personnages.victoire: one eleven-year-old girl, the tallest of all by a hair, slim and very upright with her chin lifted, light olive skin, dark brown eyes, glossy black hair in one long sleek high ponytail with a straight fringe, wearing a bright fuchsia pink polo shirt with the collar turned up, white shorts and white flip-flops, a brown leather map tube slung across her back
personnages.awa: one ten-year-old girl of medium height, athletic with strong shoulders, dark brown skin, bright dark eyes, long black braids gathered in one big round bun on top of her head, wearing a bright royal blue sailing buoyancy vest zipped over a white T-shirt, grey shorts and blue flip-flops, a silver whistle on a cord around her neck
personnages.oscar: one ten-year-old boy, short and round with a soft tummy, light golden-tan skin, dark almond-shaped eyes behind big round red-framed glasses, straight black hair in a bowl cut with a long fringe, wearing a bright purple hooded terry-cloth beach poncho down to his knees, green flip-flops, a small silver harmonica in his hand
personnages.gildas: one tall thin man of about forty-five with slightly stooped shoulders, fair weathered skin, grey eyes behind rectangular glasses, short greying brown hair and a short neat beard, wearing a slate grey waterproof sailing jacket with one narrow lime green stripe on each sleeve, dark grey trousers and grey deck shoes, headphones around his neck, holding a rugged tablet in a lime green case
personnages.job: one very old short stocky man of about eighty-five, ruddy weathered skin with deep wrinkles, pale blue eyes, thick white hair under a faded navy blue sailor's cap, a short white beard, wearing a faded brick-red canvas fisherman's smock over a navy sweater, baggy dark blue trousers and worn brown leather clogs, a piece of white chalk in his hand
personnages.gwenola: one tall strong broad-shouldered woman of about forty, fair tanned freckled skin, grey-green eyes, short curly sandy-blond hair, wearing a navy blue fisherman's sweater with a bright turquoise scarf around her neck, grey canvas trousers tucked into tall white rubber boots, a bunch of keys on a small cork float in her hand
personnages.fanch: one big round jolly man of about forty-five, fair pink skin, brown eyes, a bald head and a thick copper-red beard, wearing a white and navy striped sailor shirt under a long black apron, dark trousers and black clogs, holding a wooden crêpe spreader
personnages.daviel: one slim man of medium height of about forty-five, fair skin, brown eyes, short dark hair greying at the temples and neatly combed back, wearing a pale pink linen shirt with rolled-up sleeves, beige shorts and brown boat shoes, a mobile phone pressed to his ear
personnages.douanier: one large herring gull, white body, pale grey wings with black tips, a yellow beak with a red spot, pale yellow eyes, a blue plastic ring on its left leg

lieux.ile: a small low island of grey granite rocks and green and purple heath seen from the sea, a cluster of white houses with blue shutters and slate roofs above a little harbour closed by one long curved jetty of pink granite, a small stone chapel with a short bell tower on the highest hill, a white lighthouse with a red top at the far western tip, a huge sky with tall white clouds, late summer light
lieux.cale: the top of an old stone slipway in a small island harbour at low tide, small fishing boats lying on their sides on wet sand, beside the slipway a tiny wooden harbour hut painted sky blue, on its wall a big dark slate board with smudged chalk and no writing, under it a wooden rack with three rows of nails where small cork fishing floats painted in bright plain colours hang, a bronze ship's bell hanging from a wooden post next to the door
lieux.mole: a long curved jetty built of big blocks of pink granite, wide enough for four people to walk side by side, with iron mooring rings and a small white harbour light turret with a green top at its far end, open blue-green sea on one side and a sheltered harbour on the other
lieux.mole_basse_mer: a long curved jetty built of big blocks of pink granite, wide enough for four people to walk side by side, with iron mooring rings and a small white harbour light turret with a green top at its far end, open blue-green sea on one side and a sheltered harbour on the other, at the lowest tide, the far end of the jetty stands on bare wet sand and brown kelp, its lowest stone blocks dark and covered with barnacles, a flight of stone steps running down its side
lieux.creperie: a small crêperie on a harbour quay, a whitewashed stone house with blue shutters and a slate roof, three wooden tables outside under a faded blue awning, above the door an old carved wooden figure of a laughing woman leaning forward with windblown hair, thickly repainted in white, blue and gold
lieux.coque: an old wooden fishing boat turned upside down on a grassy dune above a small sandy cove, its tarred black hull used as a hut, a low door cut in its side with a patched piece of red sail as a curtain, a row of rubber boots lined up outside, lobster pots and coloured buoys piled around
lieux.cabine: a row of old wooden beach huts on a pale sandy beach, each painted in white and coloured stripes; the last hut, striped white and sky blue, has its door open, towels drying on a line, flip-flops scattered on its little wooden step, small sailing dinghies with white sails pulled up on the sand nearby
lieux.chapelle: the inside of a small old granite seamen's chapel, whitewashed walls, a few dark wooden benches, the ceiling a dark wooden vault shaped exactly like the hull of a ship turned upside down, with curved ribs and one long central beam like a keel; a model of a three-masted sailing ship hangs from the vault on two cords, pale light from narrow windows falls on a worn grey flagstone floor
lieux.sentinelle: a tall thin standing stone of grey granite, twice the height of a man, slightly leaning, spotted with yellow lichen, alone on a windy heath of purple heather and yellow gorse above low cliffs, the sea behind it; a low drystone wall crosses the heath in the distance, and the short bell tower of a chapel stands on the skyline
lieux.sillon: at low tide, a long narrow ridge of grey pebbles running from a rocky point across wet sand to a tiny grassy islet; on the islet stands a very small square stone guardhouse with a roof made of flat stone slabs, one low doorway and no chimney; rock pools and brown seaweed on both sides of the ridge
lieux.corps_de_garde_interieur: the inside of a tiny bare stone guardhouse, rough granite walls, a stone bench along one wall, a low ceiling made of big flat stone slabs, daylight coming in through the low doorway and one narrow slit window
lieux.chanteuses: at very low tide, a wide flat shore of wet sand and shallow pools where about forty big rounded dark blue-grey boulders lie scattered, smooth and shiny, each as large as a small car, strips of brown kelp between them, the island shore and its pebble ridge far behind
lieux.jumelles: at the lowest tide of the year, a causeway of flat dark rocks covered with seaweed leading across the bared sea floor to two tall identical pillars of grey granite standing side by side like twin towers, a narrow sandy gap between them, the sea calm and far away, a huge pale sky
lieux.chas: a narrow dry cleft between two tall granite rocks, just wide enough for a child to walk through, daylight at the far end

objets.moitie_ouest: the left half of an old hand-drawn sea chart on yellowed parchment, its right edge cut in a wavy toothed line, kept flat in a dented round biscuit tin
objets.moitie_est: the right half of an old hand-drawn sea chart on yellowed parchment, its left edge cut in a wavy toothed line, half unrolled from a brown leather tube
objets.carte: two halves of an old parchment sea chart pushed together on a wooden table along a wavy toothed cut, seen from the side, at a low angle
objets.flotteur: a small cork fishing float as big as a pear, painted in one bright plain colour, hanging from a loop of string
objets.cloche: a bronze ship's bell as big as a bucket, green with age, hanging from a wooden post, a short knotted rope under it
objets.pierre_gravee: a rough granite surface with a small anchor carved into it, seen at an angle, half in shadow
objets.herisson: a grey rigid inflatable boat with a small cabin, bristling with antennas and a white radar dome
objets.roue: a surveyor's measuring wheel on a long metal handle
objets.ancre: a very large old iron anchor, rusty and crusted with shells, lying on wet sand
objets.coffret: a flat box of dull grey lead as big as a shoebox, sealed with black pitch, crusted with a few barnacles
objets.longues_vues: two identical small brass spyglasses, each as long as a child's forearm, green with age
objets.louis: one single old gold coin as big as a thumbnail
objets.cahier: a thick notebook bound in dark waxed canvas, tied with a tarred string
